caveats.chainEffect: none beyond the already-authorized contest creation/market refresh preserved for contest 53
caveats.observation: Two safely stopped custom-runner attempts exposed an object/array parsing defect and an incorrect assumption that market refresh creates speculations.
caveats.resolution: The custom runner was abandoned. The reviewed SDK/CLI and market-maker were used directly for the successful traversal.

caveats.observation: An immediate manual scheduler invocation occupied its caller for about thirty minutes while the underlying finalizer continued writing durable evidence.
caveats.resolution: The finalizer stopped at its bounded gas cap after scoring. Receipt-aware continuation completed settlement and claims, and duplicate scheduled continuations were removed.

caveats.observation: Immediate projected reads for speculations 138 and 139 lagged confirmed settlement receipts. Speculation 139 remained stale for approximately twelve seconds.
caveats.resolution: The operator did not replay ambiguous writes. Delayed projected reads and direct contract reads confirmed terminal closed state before continuation.

caveats.observation: One immediate allowance read remained at 1.500000 USDC after a successful zero-approval receipt.
caveats.resolution: A read four seconds later returned zero; all six final allowance reads were zero.

caveats.observation: One unsupported read flag and one annotated numeric parser assumption caused local pre-write failures during continuation.
caveats.resolution: The reviewed command shape was used and the parser was corrected before any affected write.
